name: BattleSharks
objective: Survive in the 3D underwater arena, devour prey to grow, unlock cybernetic mutations, and defeat enemy hunters and the Leviathan Boss.
controls: WASD or Arrow Keys to swim and turn. Q/E or Mouse to pitch up/down. Space to Jet Dash. Left Click or F to fire lasers. Tab or U to open Upgrade Lab.
win_condition: Achieve the highest score and defeat the Leviathan Mecha-Boss.
avoid: Naval mines, toxic waste barrels, enemy harpoons/lasers, and boss torpedoes.
tips: Click Play to dive in. Eat smaller fish early to level up and gather Biomass, then open the Upgrade Lab (Tab/U) to unlock Twin Lasers and Jet Thrusters.
